bas_beijing_history.locator: Working Paper 50, printed/PDF page13 footnote33; page8 footnote20. PKU original BAS1998-2002 dataset metadata: population, collection months, sampling and response counts.
bas_beijing_history.name: Alastair Iain Johnston / RSIS, Beijing Area Study
bas_beijing_history.notes: Publication year only; no month/day verified. Historical Beijing respondents, not national China. Reported 0-100 warmth means, not favorable percentages. The source explicitly qualifies 1998, 1999 and 2002 as approximate. Separately published PKU2016catalogue records qualify ages18-65, fixed residence, eight urban districts and non-agricultural Beijing hukou. Provider collection months cross calendar years; the2001wave ends February2002, alongside RSIS's generic December/January description. Exact days, original thermometer item bases and weighting of the published means are not recovered. Restricted questionnaire/codebook/microdata files are not retrieved; public metadata is not a complete numeric survey download. No connection to Pew or China Pulse or broader later Beijing populations is inferred.

c100_china_2007.locator: Original report PDF page 14 / printed12, Q1 Chinese general-public column; PDF page62 / printed60 country sampling; PDF page3 release date.
c100_china_2007.name: Committee of 100 / Horizon Research, 2007 Chinese general public
c100_china_2007.notes: Published totals about the United States as a country, not its people or government. Publisher describes a national sample of ages18-60, drawn from seven cities, seven towns and ten villages. Not an unrestricted all-adult sample or the elite groups. Keep separate from Pew and 0-100 warmth means; archive-only, not a continuous national trend.

china_pulse.locator: Datawrapper LU2Fb: Overall and Age rows; report pages 4 and 15-16.
china_pulse.name: The Carter Center / Emory University, China Pulse
china_pulse.notes: October 2026 release; exact publication day is not supplied in the PDF. Both waves use the October release's raking weights. The reweighted 2025 mean is 33, not the earlier release's 34. Quota panel, not documented as a national probability sample; not Pew.

gallup_us_history.locator: Country ratings final topline, PDF page 4, Q17 D: China, all 2000-2026 rounds; pages 1-2 methods.
gallup_us_history.name: Gallup
gallup_us_history.notes: Telephone surveys of U.S. adults, not Pew's panel. Sampling frames and weights evolved. 2026 fieldwork February 2-16; full sample 1,001, each country item approximately 800. Published net percentages are retained despite rounding; every reported 2000 round is kept.

pew_china_2005_2006.locator: 2006 report PDF page 12, Q2a China rows: published favorable/unfavorable nets; page 11 methods. November 2005 report PDF pages 6-7: China sampling and fieldwork.
pew_china_2005_2006.name: Pew Research Center
pew_china_2005_2006.notes: Ages 18-60 in six city areas and surrounding rural areas, disproportionately urban, not nationally representative. City sets differ between rounds. Neither round is joined to the later all-adult series or to China Pulse warmth scores.

pew_china_history.locator: Page 13: Fluctuating views of the U.S., Q10a; published net percentages.
pew_china_history.name: Pew Research Center
pew_china_history.notes: Nets are read directly, not summed from separately rounded response components. Earlier survey coverage varies; no line is drawn across these samples or to the different 2025-2026 China Pulse measure.

pew_us_age.locator: Appendix: Views of China by age, U.S. row; U.S. survey methodology.
pew_us_age.name: Pew Research Center
pew_us_age.notes: This is the same March 23-29 U.S. survey as the April trend release, not another survey in July.

pew_us_trend.locator: First embedded table: full U.S. favorable/unfavorable phone and ATP trends.
pew_us_trend.name: Pew Research Center
pew_us_trend.notes: Chart dates such as March 1 are positioning dates, not verified fieldwork. Unknown historical field dates stay null. Phone and probability-panel histories are separate.

pew_us_warmth.locator: Article's published mean-rating table and age paragraph; topline THERMO_CHINA.
pew_us_warmth.name: Pew Research Center
pew_us_warmth.notes: Mean ratings transcribed from the publisher's public article and embedded data table, checked through the public web source viewer on October 24, 2026. Direct article retrieval returned HTTP 403. The separately retrieved topline PDF verifies the question, field periods and 2026 China-item sample size; it does not contain these means. These are published means, not means reconstructed from rounded response categories.
